title: Fair Policy Optimization in Major-Minor Weakly Coupled Markov Decision Processes
abstract: arXiv:2609.36174v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We consider fair resource allocation in sequential decision-making environments modeled as major-minor weakly coupled Markov decision processes (M2WCMDP). In this framework, resource constraints couple the action spaces of a major sub-Markov decision process (sub-MDP) and a population of minor sub-MDPs that would otherwise operate independently. Instead of using the traditional utilitarian (total-sum) objective, we optimize a general class of monotone, concave, permutation-invariant, normalized fairness functions. With homogeneous minor sub-MDPs, we prove that the problem under symmetry reduces to optimizing the platform-plus-mean-participant utilitarian objective over the class of \textit{permutation-invariant} policies, which allows us to exploit efficient algorithms that optimize the utilitarian-based objective to solve this fairness-aware problem. translated_title: 主-次弱耦合马尔可夫决策过程中的公平策略优化
translated_abstract: 我们考虑在建模为主-次弱耦合马尔可夫决策过程（M2WCMDP）的序贯决策环境中进行公平的资源分配。在该框架中，资源约束将一个主子马尔可夫决策过程（子MDP）和一群原本可独立运行的次子MDP的动作空间耦合在一起。我们没有采用传统的功利主义（总和）目标，而是优化一类通用的单调、凹、置换不变、归一化的公平性函数。对于同质的次子MDP，我们证明了对称性下的该问题可归约为在置换不变策略类上优化“平台加平均参与者”的功利主义目标，这使我们能够利用优化基于功利主义目标的高效算法来解决这一公平感知问题。对于更一般的设置，我们引入了一种基于计数比例的深度强化学习算法（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文针对主-次弱耦合马尔可夫决策过程研究公平资源分配，证明了同质情形下公平优化问题可归约为置换不变策略类上的功利主义目标优化，并可借助高效算法求解，同时针对一般情形提出了基于计数比例的深度强化学习算法。
en_tdlr: This paper addresses fair resource allocation in major-minor weakly coupled MDPs by proving that, under symmetry and homogeneous minor sub-MDPs, the fairness-aware problem reduces to utilitarian optimization over permutation-invariant policies, and introduces a count-proportion-based deep reinforcement learning algorithm for more general settings.
